ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can model contaminant spread and draft reports, but people who work on-site and own the project must still revise remediation plans for approval and respond when construction goes wrong.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 1,333,700 specialists and managers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to increase to 1,393,500 by 2034, a net gain of about 59,800 jobs, with approximately 106,700 openings each year. Median annual pay is about $136,500 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Brownfield Redevelopment Specialists And Site Managers, but it will shift their focus. AI greatly accelerates contaminant-transport modeling, monitoring-data analysis, and report drafting. People must make remediation decisions, coordinate approvals, and manage construction because those responsibilities involve multiple stakeholders and clear accountability. Specialists will spend less time writing reports and more time making decisions.
ai_s3_list: Plan decisions: balance technology, cost, and schedule.
Process coordination: align approvals and construction.
Stakeholder coordination: balance the interests of owners, regulators, and contractors.
On-site judgment: control risks when construction exceptions occur.
Compliance oversight: ensure data and procedures withstand review.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10, moderate, means brownfield redevelopment is a professional management field with meaningful AI exposure. AI accelerates technical work such as data analysis and report generation, while people remain responsible for project decisions, approval coordination, and site management. The role is shifting toward coordination and judgment.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Meaningful exposure does not mean unemployment. Use AI to reduce the time spent on technical reports and devote more time to approvals and field management. Coordination, not report writing, is the recurring project bottleneck.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Environmental engineering, civil engineering, and geology are direct routes into the field. Work with faculty on contaminated-site projects, learn environmental assessment and remediation methods, and study project management. Technical knowledge plus management ability is the strongest combination.

Earn credentials such as registered environmental impact assessment engineer or construction engineer and move toward project leadership. Use AI tools for reports and data analysis, then devote your time to coordination and decisions. Project integration is your durable advantage.

People with environmental assessment, construction, or real-estate experience can transition into this field. Begin with investigation and remediation-plan work, then build project-management ability. In interviews, emphasize endurance and coordination and describe an approval process you successfully advanced.

Brownfield talent is difficult to recruit. Retain people through project bonuses, credential subsidies, and defined career paths. Use AI tools to improve team capacity while assigning experienced staff to critical negotiations and approvals.

ai_s7_trends: Urban-renewal and soil-pollution-control policies increase brownfield projects.
Development models such as EOD integrate remediation with development and increase demand for multidisciplinary talent.
AI accelerates reports and data analysis, shifting specialists toward project coordination.

body: Brownfield Redevelopment Specialists And Site Managers coordinate the full redevelopment of contaminated industrial land. They manage contamination investigations, remediation-plan design, administrative approvals, construction, acceptance, and handover so brownfields can safely return to urban use.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能模拟污染物扩散、自动生成报告，但「这块地的修复方案怎么改才能过审、施工出了岔子怎么办」，还得靠跑现场、扛项目的人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年专家经理在岗约 133.37 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 139.35 万人，净增约 5.98 万个岗位，年均产生约 10.67 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 13.65 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代棕地修复专家，但会改写工作重心：污染物迁移模拟、监测数据分析、报告初稿这些环节正被 AI 大幅加速；而方案决策、审批协调、施工管理这些牵涉多方利益和责任的项目统筹，必须由人来拍板。专家会从「写报告」转向「做决策」。
ai_s2_accel: AI 辅助修复工艺比选
遥感与无人机污染巡查
ai_s2_auto: 土壤监测数据自动分析
进度与成本报表自动化
ai_s3_list: 方案决策：技术、成本、工期怎么权衡。
流程统筹：把审批和施工拧成一股绳。
多方协调：业主、监管、施工利益平衡。
现场判断：施工异常的风险把控。
合规把关：数据与程序经得起审查。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明棕地修复是「中高曝光」的专业管理岗：数据分析、报告生成这些技术活正被 AI 加速，但项目决策、审批协调和现场管理仍需人，岗位重心向统筹与判断转移。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于失业，反而要主动拥抱：AI 把技术报告的时间压缩下来，你就有更多时间跑审批、管现场——项目的瓶颈从来不是写报告，是协调。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 环境工程、土木、地质专业是正路，大学期间多跟导师做污染场地项目，把环评和修复工艺跑熟；建议同时学项目管理，技术加管理是这行最好的组合。
把注册环境影响评价师、建造师证考下来，往项目负责人走；用 AI 工具把报告和数据分析外包出去，把时间用在协调和决策上，你的不可替代性在项目统筹。
有环评、施工或地产经验的可以转：先跟项目做调查和方案，再补项目管理能力；面试时强调能扛周期、能协调，讲一个你推进过审批的项目最加分。
棕地项目人才难找，建议「项目奖金 + 考证补贴 + 职业通道」留人；用 AI 工具提升团队产能，把熟手放在谈判和审批的关键环节上。

ai_s7_trends: 城市更新与土壤污染防治政策带动棕地项目增长。
EOD 等开发模式让「修复 + 开发」一体化，人才复合化。
AI 加速报告与数据分析，专家重心转向项目统筹。

body: 棕地再开发专家与现场经理统筹污染工业地块的再开发全流程，负责污染调查、修复方案设计、行政审批、施工管理与验收交付，让棕地安全地重新进入城市用地。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Automated modeling can create charts, but analysts still decide which metrics to build, how to define them, and how to explain conclusions.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 245,900 business intelligence analysts were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to increase to 328,300 by 2034, a net gain of about 82,400 jobs, with approximately 23,400 openings each year. Median annual pay is about $112,600 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Business Intelligence Analysts, but it will reduce data retrieval and report production. Self-service BI and automated modeling accelerate routine reporting, shifting analysts toward metric governance, business interpretation, and decision support. People limited to pulling data face displacement, while those who govern metrics and interpret results become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Metric governance: people define standards.
Business translation: people frame the question.
Conclusion interpretation: people explain causality.
Definition balancing: people make tradeoffs.
Decision support: people provide recommendations.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 8/10, relatively high, means this occupation has high AI exposure in data retrieval. Systems accelerate routine reports, while people retain governance and interpretation.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Relatively high exposure does not mean high risk. AI replaces data pulling and report production, not metric-governance roles. People who govern metrics and interpret results become scarcer as productivity improves. Analysts limited to data retrieval face the greatest pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Begin with computer science or statistics and develop business judgment. Pure data retrieval is shrinking in the AI era, so practice governance early.
Progress from building reports to managing metrics and explaining the business. Learn governance frameworks and pursue ownership of the system.
Emphasize metric and dashboard projects and identify the business functions you served. Employers value reliability and business understanding.
Do not hire on SQL alone. Assess whether candidates think in terms of governance. Professionals who explain the business deserve higher pay.

ai_s7_trends: Self-service BI spreads, reducing data-retrieval work.
Metric governance creates opportunities.
Analysts who interpret results become more sought after.

body: Business intelligence analysts integrate data from multiple enterprise sources, build metric systems and visualization dashboards, and support operating analysis and business decisions.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 自动建模能出图，但哪类指标该建、口径怎么定、结论怎么讲，还是分析师定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年分析师商业在岗约 24.59 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 32.83 万人，净增约 8.24 万个岗位，年均产生约 2.34 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 11.26 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代 BI 分析师，但会压缩取数做表。自助 BI 与自动建模把常规报表提速，分析师从「拉数」挪向「指标治理、业务解读、决策支持」。真正被挤掉的是只做取数的人，会治理能解读的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 指标治理：口径靠人定。
业务翻译：问题靠人翻。
结论解读：因果靠人讲。
口径平衡：取舍靠人。
决策支持：建议靠人给。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 8/10 说明这个职业处在高 AI 曝光的取数区——常规报表被系统加速，但治理与解读还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「拉数做表」动作，不是「指标治理」的岗位。会治理、能解读的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会取数的分析师。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 计算机/统计起步多练业务感，AI 时代纯取数在缩，早点练治理。
从「做表」升级成「管指标 + 讲业务」，学治理框架，争取体系负责。
突出指标与看板项目，写清服务过哪些业务。用人方看重稳和懂。
选人别只看 SQL，要看有没有治理脑子。能讲业务的骨干，值得给高薪。

ai_s7_trends: 自助 BI 普及，取数缩。
指标治理带来机会。
会解读的分析师更抢手。

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Computer Systems Analysts, but it will reduce routine requirements work. AI accelerates drafts and documentation, while analysts shift toward business judgment, prioritization, solution tradeoffs, and implementation follow-through. People who only relay requirements face the most pressure.
ai_s3_list: Business judgment: people identify the real problem.
Solution tradeoffs: people choose what to sacrifice.
Prioritization: people allocate resources.
Implementation follow-through: people drive progress.
Cross-functional coordination: people define boundaries.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 8/10 places Computer Systems Analysts in the relatively high AI exposure range. AI accelerates routine documentation, while people retain business judgment and tradeoff decisions.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: High exposure does not mean high risk. AI replaces requirements relaying, not business judgment or solution tradeoffs. Analysts who only move requirements and lack business knowledge face the most pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build strong technical fundamentals and communication skills. Pure documentation work is shrinking in the AI era.
Move beyond writing documents into judgment and implementation. Learn the industry and systems architecture.
Show industry knowledge and implemented projects. Describe the business problems you have solved.
Evaluate candidates on business understanding and tradeoff judgment, not process-diagram skills alone.

ai_s7_trends: Low-code tools reduce documentation work.
System-modernization demand rises.
Industry knowledge becomes more sought after.

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代系统分析师，但会压低常规梳理。AI 把需求草稿与文档提速，分析师从「写文档」挪向「业务判断、优先级、方案权衡与落地跟进」。真正被挤的是只做搬运需求的人。
ai_s3_list: 业务判断：真问题靠人。
方案权衡：取舍靠人。
优先级：资源靠人。
落地跟进：推动靠人。
跨方协同：边界靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 8/10 说明系统分析师处于高 AI 曝光区——常规文档被加速，但业务与权衡还留人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是文档搬运，不是业务判断与方案权衡。怕的是只做需求搬运、不懂业务的人。

从「写文档」升级成「做判断 + 落地」，学行业与架构。
突出行业与落地项目，写明解过哪些痛点。
选人看业务理解与权衡力，别只看会画流程图。

ai_s7_trends: 低代码压文档。
系统现代化升。
行业理解更抢手。

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Economics Teachers, Postsecondary, but it will reduce standard lesson preparation. Econometric and presentation tools accelerate data processing and lecture-note creation. Teachers shift toward empirical research, scholarship, critical discussion, and thesis feedback. Instructors who only read slides face the most pressure, while those with empirical and mentoring skills become more valuable.
ai_s2_auto: Automated test assembly from question banks
ai_s3_list: Model specification: people make the tradeoffs.
Causal identification: people make the judgment.
Academic guidance: people develop critical thinking.
Thesis supervision: people set direction.
Value tradeoffs: people determine the position.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 7/10 places this occupation in the moderate-high AI exposure range for teaching. Tools accelerate standard lesson preparation, while empirical judgment and academic guidance remain human responsibilities.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure does not mean high replacement risk. Reading standard slides is vulnerable, but academic guidance remains. Teachers with empirical and mentoring skills become scarcer as tools improve efficiency. Those limited to standard preparation face the greatest pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build empirical and writing skills while studying economics or econometrics. Pure lesson preparation is shrinking, so practice academic guidance early.
Advance from lecturing to supervising empirical work and leading grant applications. Learn econometrics and work toward responsibility for an academic field.
Highlight publications and empirical work, including the research areas you have covered.
Do not hire based on degrees alone. Assess whether candidates can supervise research. Teachers who foster critical thinking are worth retaining.

ai_s7_trends: Econometric tools are becoming widespread, reducing preparation time.
The digital economy creates opportunities.
Professionals who guide others effectively are in greater demand.

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代高校教师，但会压缩标准备课。计量与课件工具把数据处理和讲义生成提速，教师从「备标准课」挪向「带实证、做研究、引导思辨、改论文」。真正被挤掉的是只念 PPT 的人，有实证和引导力的人更值钱。

ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的教师区——标准备课被加速，但实证与引导还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「念标准 PPT」动作，不是「学术引导」的岗位。有实证和引导力的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只做标准备课的人。

数据经济带来机会。
会引导的人更抢手。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can build schedules, replenish inventory, and prepare reports, but supervisors still resolve employee issues, customer complaints, and declining performance.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 1.4326 million sales worker supervisors employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 1.3603 million by 2034, a net decline of about 72,300 jobs, with about 125,100 annual openings. The 2026 median annual wage is about $47,300 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace retail supervisors, but it will change how they manage. AI takes over scheduling, attendance, inventory replenishment, performance reports, and promotional messages. Supervisors shift from manual accounting and stock control toward data-driven operations and team management. On-site coordination, employee motivation, complaint handling, and performance leadership remain human responsibilities. AI shows the numbers, but supervisors determine why they changed, how to recover, and how to lead the team.
ai_s2_accel: Traffic analysis for merchandising and scheduling
Integrated online and in-store order management
Pilot AI shopping assistants and smart fitting rooms
ai_s3_list: Employee management and motivation: people discuss poor performance and retention with staff.
On-site coordination: supervisors respond to traffic surges, staffing gaps, and equipment failures.
Complaint and crisis handling: people calm distressed customers and contain reputation risk.
Performance leadership and diagnosis: people judge whether merchandising, service, or inventory caused a decline.
Store accountability: supervisors own performance and safety; machines cannot accept responsibility.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 places this career in the moderate AI exposure range. Systems now handle scheduling, replenishment, and reports.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not mean high job risk. As data systems spread, supervisors need stronger data and leadership skills. Operational judgment and employee management become more important. Experience-only supervisors who rely on old methods face pressure. Retail supervisors who analyze data and understand operations advance more reliably toward store and regional management.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Avoid entering directly as a supervisor without experience. Start in a store and study marketing or retail operations while building data skills. Plan toward store management and operations leadership.

Master traffic analysis and store dashboards. Use them to improve merchandising and review promotions. Advancing from experience-based management to data-driven operations strengthens promotion prospects.
Candidates with sales or team-management experience can target retail supervisor roles. Resumes should state team size, target attainment, complaints resolved, and merchandising improvements.
Do not assess supervisors only by tenure. Look for data awareness and team leadership. Managers who use operations tools and stabilize teams are essential to store expansion.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Real-time sales, traffic, and conversion dashboard

ai_s7_trends: Store management becomes fully data-driven. Supervisors shift from experience-based management toward data operations and team leadership, making analytics a standard skill.
Self-checkout and intelligent replenishment reduce basic management tasks. Stores shift toward experience and service, giving supervisors more time for employees and customers.
Chain expansion and store-manager shortages create strong advancement paths for retail supervisors who understand operations and lead teams.

body: First Line Supervisors Of Retail Sales Workers manage store operations and teams. They oversee scheduling, attendance, performance targets, replenishment, merchandising, and complaints, while coordinating with headquarters.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can build schedules, replenish inventory, and prepare reports, but supervisors still resolve employee issues, customer complaints, and declining performance.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能帮你排班、补货、做报表，但员工情绪、客诉现场、业绩上不去的症结，还得主管去解决。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年主管工人销售在岗约 143.26 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 136.03 万人，岗位净减约 7.23 万个，年均产生约 12.51 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.73 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代零售主管，但会改变管理方式。排班考勤、库存补货、业绩报表、促销推送都被 AI 接手，主管从「手工算账管货」转向「数据运营 + 团队管理」。真正不可替代的是现场调度、员工激励、客诉处理，以及业绩目标的推动——AI 能告诉你数据，但「为什么掉、怎么追、人怎么带」要靠主管。
ai_s2_accel: 客流分析辅助陈列与排班
线上线下一体化订单管理
AI 导购与智能试衣间试点
ai_s2_auto: 促销与会员推送自动化
ai_s3_list: 员工管理与激励：店员状态差、想离职，怎么谈、怎么带靠人。
现场调度：突发客流、缺岗、设备故障，临场安排靠主管。
客诉与危机处理：顾客情绪激动、舆情风险，现场接住靠人。
业绩推动与诊断：数据掉了，是陈列、是服务还是库存问题，靠判断。
门店经营责任：业绩和安全责任落到主管头上，机器担不了责。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业的流程与管理环节正被自动化——排班、补货、报表都有系统代劳。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险。恰恰因为数据系统普及，主管被要求「更会看数据、更会带团队」，运营判断和员工管理反而更重要。真正被挤压的是纯经验型、只会按老办法管店的主管，会数据分析、懂运营的零售主管向店长和区域管理走得更稳。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 不建议直接空降主管。从店员做起攒门店经验，同时读市场营销或零售运营专业，把数据分析能力补上，向店长和运营管理规划。
把客流分析、经营数据看板用熟，主动做陈列优化和促销复盘。从「经验管店」升级为「数据运营」，晋升店长和区域督导更有底气。
有销售或团队管理经验者可关注零售主管岗。简历上多写「带过多少人、业绩达成率、处理过哪些客诉、优化过什么陈列」。
招主管别只看资历，要看数据敏感度和带团队能力。会用经营数据工具、又能稳定团队的人，是门店扩张最需要的管理者。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 销售、客流、转化实时看板

ai_s7_trends: 门店管理全面数据化，主管从「经验管店」转向「数据运营 + 团队管理」，数据分析能力成为标配。
自助收银与智能补货压缩基础管理环节，门店向体验与服务转型，主管更多精力放在人和顾客上。
连锁扩张与店长人才缺口并存，会运营、能带队的零售主管向店长与区域督导发展空间大。

body: 零售主管负责零售门店的运营与团队管理，涵盖排班考勤、业绩目标、库存补货、陈列与客诉处理，并对接总部与上级，是零售行业承上启下的一线管理者。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can take orders, process payment, and route meals, but a person still says, "Your order is ready. Have a good day," during the rush.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 3,796,000 Fast Food And Counter Workers employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 4,029,200 by 2034, a net gain of about 233,200 jobs, with about 904,300 annual openings. The 2026 median annual wage is about $30,500 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will replace some Fast Food And Counter Workers. Self-service ordering, checkout, and intelligent pickup equipment already absorb repetitive steps. Workers shift from taking orders and assembling meals toward customer experience and on-site response. They resolve line disputes, reassure waiting customers, and handle disruptions. Machines can produce an order, but face-to-face warmth and coordination still require people.
ai_s2_accel: Pilot intelligent pickup and robotic meal assembly
ai_s2_auto: Automatic acceptance and routing of delivery orders
ai_s3_list: Rush coordination: people keep long lines and backed-up orders moving.
Customer reassurance: people resolve long waits, wrong orders, and dissatisfaction on site.
Task switching: people coordinate ordering, pickup, and cleaning at the same time.
Service warmth: a greeting for a regular or patience with a child encourages return visits.
Disruption response: people handle equipment failures, supply shortages, and sanitation problems.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 indicates low-moderate AI exposure. Transaction and process tasks such as ordering, checkout, and restocking are being automated.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low-moderate exposure does not mean high risk. As AI absorbs transactions, workers need stronger service and response skills. Customer experience and on-site coordination become more important. Order-taking-only roles face pressure, while advancement to shift manager or store manager offers a stable path.

ai_s5_persona.建议: This role suits student work and transitional employment, but it is weak as a long-term plan. People staying in food service should study restaurant management or chain operations and advance toward shift, store, or regional management.
Seek crew-lead and shift-manager training. Learn scheduling, inventory, and store operations. Moving from assembling meals to managing a store improves income and work patterns.
The role has low entry barriers and fast training, making it suitable for transitional work. On a resume, emphasize rush-hour service, shift leadership, and in-store promotion execution.

Do not hire workers only for diligence. Assess willingness to learn and advancement potential. Employees who learn store operations and adapt to self-service equipment are strong candidates for management tracks.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Automatic order acceptance and pickup alerts
Meal warming, number calling, and pickup

ai_s7_trends: Self-service ordering and intelligent pickup are spreading. Frontline order-taking roles are shrinking as staffing shifts toward customer experience and operational management.
Standardized chain operations are accelerating. Store managers who lead shifts, understand data, and run locations remain scarce.
Unattended-store pilots are increasing, but customer experience and on-site response still require people. Service roles will upgrade rather than disappear.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能帮你点单、收银、配餐，但高峰时段那句「您的餐好了，慢走」，还得人来说。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年快餐与柜台服务员在岗约 379.60 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 402.92 万人，净增约 23.32 万个岗位，年均产生约 90.43 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 3.05 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 会替代一部分快餐柜台岗位，自助点单机、自助收银、智能出餐设备已经在分流重复环节。服务员从「点单打餐」转向「顾客体验与现场应变」：处理排队纠纷、安抚等待顾客、应对突发情况。真正不可替代的是面对面的服务温度、现场协调和突发处置——机器出得了餐，但顾不了「人」。
ai_s2_accel: 智能出餐与机器人配餐试点
后厨自动化减少配餐人力
ai_s2_auto: 外卖订单自动接单与分单
库存与物料自动补货提醒
会员与促销推送自动化
ai_s3_list: 高峰现场协调：队伍排长、单子积压，怎么稳住节奏靠人。
顾客情绪安抚：等太久、点错餐、不满意，现场化解靠人。
多任务切换：点单、出餐、清洁同时进行，机器做不了这种统筹。
服务温度：熟客的一句问候、小朋友的耐心，是复购的种子。
突发处理：机器故障、物料短缺、卫生问题，临场应对靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业的交易与流程环节正被自动化——点单、收银、补货都有系统代劳。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险。恰恰因为交易被 AI 接管，服务员被要求「更会服务、更会应变」，顾客体验和现场协调反而更重要。真正被挤压的是纯点单打餐岗位，向值班经理和店长方向走，是稳定的出路。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 适合学生兼职和过渡就业，不建议长期规划。想留在餐饮业，读餐饮管理或连锁运营专业，往值班经理、店长和区域管理方向走。
主动争取带班和值班经理培训，学会排班、盘点、门店运营。从「打餐」升级为「管店」，收入和生活节奏都会上一个台阶。
门槛低、上手快，适合找过渡工作的人。简历上多写「服务高峰处理、值班带班、门店活动执行」这类经历。
招服务员别只看勤快，要看学习意愿和晋升潜力。愿意学门店运营、能适应自助点单设备的员工，是店长梯队的好苗子。

ai_s7_trends: 自助点单与智能出餐普及，一线点单打餐岗位收缩，门店用工向「体验服务与运营管理」集中。
连锁餐饮标准化运营加速，会带班、懂数据、能管店的店长人才持续紧缺。
无人化试点增加，但顾客体验与现场应变仍靠人，服务岗位不会消失只会升级。

body: 快餐与柜台服务员在快餐与简餐门店从事点单收银、出餐配餐、餐区清洁与顾客服务，直接面对顾客完成快速餐饮服务流程，是餐饮行业的基础岗位。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can complete remote-sensing classifications, but faculty judgment still determines which human-environment relationship deserves study and where a student is struggling.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 4,000 workers in 2024, projected to rise to 4,200 by 2034. That is a net gain of about 200 jobs, with roughly 300 annual openings. Median annual pay is about $86,700 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Postsecondary Geography Teachers, but it will accelerate research and teaching. GIS, remote sensing, and AI analysis speed data processing, while online courses and intelligent tutoring absorb basic instruction. Faculty work shifts from presenting facts toward research guidance, scholarly judgment, and classroom inspiration. Instructors limited to reading slides face pressure, while strong researchers and mentors become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Research topic selection: people determine value.
Classroom inspiration: people guide thinking.
Thesis supervision: people guide direction.
Field judgment: people assess real conditions.
Academic judgment: people distinguish reliable findings.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 7/10 score places this occupation in a moderate-high AI exposure range. Systems accelerate analysis and basic instruction, while people retain responsibility for research topics and student guidance.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure does not mean complete replacement. AI replaces slide reading and routine data processing, not scholarly judgment and student inspiration. Faculty who choose strong research questions and mentor effectively become scarcer as tools improve. Instructors limited to rote delivery face the greatest pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation through an undergraduate geography degree and join a research group early. Pure teaching roles are shrinking in the AI era, so develop research skills as soon as possible.
Progress from lecturing to research topic selection and guidance, and learn GIS and AI tools.
Emphasize publications and projects, clearly describing your research direction and outputs.
Do not evaluate candidates only by teaching hours. Assess research and mentoring ability, and provide stable positions to faculty who can lead a research direction.

ai_s7_trends: Demand for GIS and remote-sensing expertise is rising.
Online learning and AI are absorbing basic instruction.
Faculty with research strength and inspiring teaching are in greater demand.

body: Geography Teachers, Postsecondary teach physical and human geography, supervise graduate students, conduct remote-sensing and regional research, publish papers, apply for grants, and contribute to teaching, research, and academic program development.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can complete remote-sensing classifications, but faculty judgment still determines which human-environment relationship deserves study and where a student is struggling.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能跑通遥感分类，但哪条人地关系值得研究、学生卡在哪，还是老师凭眼光定的。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年高校地理教师在岗约 0.40 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 0.42 万人，净增约 0.02 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.03 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 8.67 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代高校地理教师，但会加速科研与教学。GIS、遥感与 AI 分析把数据处理提速，在线课与智能辅导分流基础教学，教师从「讲知识点」挪向「选题指导 + 科研判断 + 课堂启发」。真正被挤掉的是只念 PPT 的人，有科研能启发的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 科研选题：价值靠人定。
课堂启发：思维靠人引。
论文指导：方向靠人把。
野外判断：现场靠人看。
学术判断：真伪靠人辨。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的科研教学区——分析与基础教学被系统提速，选题与指导还留人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于全替代：被替代的是「念 PPT 与跑数据」动作，不是「科研判断与启发」的岗位。有选题力、能带人的老师反而随工具更稀缺。怕的是只会照本宣科的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 地理本科打底，早进组做研究。AI 时代纯教学在缩，早点练科研。
从「讲课」升级成「选题 + 指导」，学 GIS 和 AI 工具。
突出论文与项目，写清方向和产出。
选人别只看课时，看科研与指导力。能带方向的老师值得给编制。

ai_s7_trends: GIS 与遥感需求涨。
在线与 AI 分流基础教学。
有科研能启发的老师更抢手。

body: 高校地理教师讲授自然与人文地理，指导研究生，开展遥感与区域研究，撰写论文并申请基金，承担教学、科研与学科建设职责。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can absorb much of the repetitive, structurable work of Information Security Analysts, but judgment, accountability, and interpersonal coordination still rest with people. What actually gets squeezed out is pure execution.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that there will be approximately 182,800 information security analysts on the job in 2024, and this number is expected to rise to 234,900 by 2034, with a net increase of approximately 52,100 positions, an average of approximately 16,000 job vacancies per year, and a median annual salary of approximately US$124,900 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace information security analysts, but it will reshape the workflow of Information Security Analysts: handing over repetitive and structurable tasks to tools, and people will focus on judgment, responsibility and creativity. What is really squeezed out is those who execute according to the script. People who can combine real scenarios and make decisions are more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: Use data portraits to accelerate Information Security Analysts’ customer/study judgments.
Use simulation and sandbox to accelerate the solution deduction of Information Security Analysts.
Enhance Information Security Analysts' information and regulatory verification with search.
Accelerate cross-team collaboration of Information Security Analysts with collaboration tools.
ai_s2_auto: Automatically generate structured documents and reports related to Information Security Analysts.
Processing and categorization of repetitive data for Information Security Analysts.
Rule-based preliminary screening and scheduling of Information Security Analysts.
Information Security Analysts knowledge base retrieval and key point extraction.
ai_s3_list: Professional judgment and trade-offs in real Information Security Analysts scenarios.
The expressiveness to convey the professional knowledge of Information Security Analysts to laypeople.
Responsibility and final review in the field of Information Security Analysts.
Cross-border Information Security Analysts resource integration and interpersonal coordination.
Information Security Analysts' long-term experience in tacit knowledge reuse.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: Scoring logic: Information Security Analysts can be assisted by AI, but "professional judgment" and "final responsibility review" are difficult to replace, so 8/10 is exposed.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Turn 8/10 into an advantage: let AI take the repetitive work, and spend your time on real projects, judgment, and people.

ai_s5_persona.建议: First lay a solid foundation for Information Security Analysts and accumulate real projects.
Use existing experience to connect with Information Security Analysts to find differentiation.
Productize/manage the experience of Information Security Analysts to increase leverage.
Use AI to free Information Security Analysts from repetitive tasks and focus on decision-making.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Information Security AnalystsCopywriting and proposal drafts

ai_s7_trends: First, the collaboration between Information Security Analysts and AI has become the norm, and tool literacy has become the threshold.
Second, the high value judgment and responsibility links of Information Security Analysts are even scarcer.
Third, the position of Information Security Analysts has evolved into a compound of "professional + management/product".

body: Information Security Analysts monitor logs, manage firewalls and postures, detect intrusions, stop bleeding, and conduct review to protect corporate data and systems.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can absorb much of the repetitive, structurable work of Information Security Analysts, but judgment, accountability, and interpersonal coordination still rest with people. What actually gets squeezed out is pure execution.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能吞掉信息安全分析师的大量重复与可结构化任务，但判断、责任与人际协调仍由人扛；真正被挤掉的是纯执行层。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年信息安全分析师在岗约 18.28 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 23.49 万人，净增约 5.21 万个岗位，年均产生约 1.60 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 12.49 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代信息安全分析师，但会重塑Information Security Analysts的作业流：把重复与可结构化任务交给工具，人聚焦判断、责任与创造。真正被挤掉的是照本宣科式执行，会结合真实场景、会决策的人更值钱。
ai_s2_accel: 用数据画像加速Information Security Analysts的客情/学情判断。
用模拟与沙盘加速Information Security Analysts的方案推演。
用检索增强Information Security Analysts的资料与法规查证。
用协作工具加速Information Security Analysts的跨团队协同。
ai_s2_auto: 自动生成Information Security Analysts相关的结构化文档与报告。
对Information Security Analysts的重复性数据处理与归类。
基于规则的Information Security Analysts初步筛查与排程。
Information Security Analysts知识库检索与要点提取。
ai_s3_list: 真实Information Security Analysts场景下的专业判断与权衡。
把Information Security Analysts专业知识讲给外行听的表达力。
Information Security Analysts领域的责任承担与终审。
跨边界的Information Security Analysts资源整合与人际协调。
Information Security Analysts长期经验的隐性知识复用。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 评分逻辑：Information Security Analysts可被 AI 辅助，但「专业判断」与「责任终审」难替代，故8/10 曝光。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 把 8/10 变成优势：用 AI 解放重复劳动，把时间花在真实项目、判断与人际上。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 先把Information Security Analysts基础打牢，积累真实项目。
用既有经验对接Information Security Analysts，找差异化切口。
把Information Security Analysts经验产品化/管理化，放大杠杆。
用 AI 解放Information Security Analysts重复劳动，聚焦决策。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Information Security Analysts文案与方案草稿

ai_s7_trends: 一是Information Security Analysts与 AI 协同成为常态，工具素养成门槛。
二是Information Security Analysts的高价值判断与责任环节更稀缺。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can calculate risks, interpret data, and write reports, but physicians must communicate how a person should change their lifestyle and whether they are willing to change.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 340,700 preventive medicine physicians were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 349,300 by 2034, a net increase of about 8,600 jobs, with about 9,600 openings annually. Median annual pay was ≥$239,200 in 2024 (top BLS OES category, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace preventive medicine physicians, but it will change how they work. AI is taking over health data analysis, risk assessment models, and report generation, shifting physicians from experience-based interpretation to interpreting AI results and designing individualized interventions. What remains irreplaceable is comprehensive judgment of individual circumstances, physician-patient communication and behavioral intervention, and accountability for public health decisions. AI can calculate a risk score, but people must decide how to intervene, implement the plan, and take responsibility.

ai_s2_auto: Health data analysis and risk scoring

ai_s3_list: Individualized interventions: the same report calls for different changes for different people, requiring physician judgment.
Physician-patient communication and behavior change: trust and communication are essential to help patients truly change their habits.
Accountability for public health decisions: physicians and institutions are responsible for screening strategies and vaccination arrangements.
Interdisciplinary judgment: lifestyle, psychological, and environmental factors interact and require holistic thinking.
Clinical sensitivity: AI can flag abnormalities, but physicians must identify the problems potentially hidden behind them.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 means this occupation's data and analytical work is being automated. Systems can handle risk scoring, first report drafts, and statistical analysis.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: But moderately high exposure does not mean high risk. As AI takes over data analysis, physicians are expected to become better at interpretation, communication, and intervention. Individualized intervention and physician-patient communication become even scarcer. Pure data organization is being reduced, while versatile preventive medicine professionals who understand data, can manage programs, and can implement solutions are more valuable.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study clinical or preventive medicine and plan your residency training path carefully. Preventive medicine employment focuses on public health and health management, so choose based on policy direction and personal interests rather than the physician title alone.

Learn health data tools, risk models, and wearable monitoring, and proactively participate in health management and chronic disease programs. Advance from writing reports to managing populations and delivering interventions, supporting smoother career and professional-title progression.

People with clinical or public health backgrounds can transition into prevention, with health management companies and insurers offering market-based opportunities. Obtain relevant health management credentials and strengthen data analysis skills.

When hiring preventive medicine professionals, look beyond education to program implementation and population management ability. People who use AI tools efficiently and can deliver community-level interventions are core members of public health and health management teams.

Continuous monitoring of heart rate, sleep, and physical activity
Integrated health examination and medical history records

As remote health management and follow-up mature, primary-level preventive services improve and physicians shift toward population management and program operations.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Literature reviews can be assigned to AI, but AI cannot provide the standpoint needed to judge which structures underlie a phenomenon.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 15,400 postsecondary sociology teachers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 15,700 by 2034, a net increase of about 300 jobs, with approximately 1,100 openings per year. Median annual pay was about $82,500 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace postsecondary sociology teachers, but it will take over substantial desk work: literature reviews, data cleaning, draft organization, and assignment grading. AI is handling tasks that consume much of social-science faculty time. Sociology education, however, centers on teaching people to think. Guiding classroom discussion, identifying weaknesses in student research designs, and defining the boundary between evidence and conclusions all depend on teachers' academic experience and value-based perspective and cannot be replaced by AI.
ai_s2_accel: AI-assisted coding of interview transcripts and field notes
Social computation and text mining enter the classroom
Lower barriers to large-scale social-data analysis
ai_s3_list: Theoretical judgment: moving from a phenomenon to an explanatory framework requires disciplinary depth.
Methodological guidance: people diagnose problems in student research designs.
Academic ethics: prevent AI ghostwriting and data fabrication and protect integrity.
Classroom guidance: manage discussion pace and intellectual disagreement.
Value-based perspective: transmit social concern and critical thinking.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 7/10 reflects substantial AI exposure across desk-based social-science research, including literature, data, and writing, placing the occupation at medium-high exposure.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Medium-high exposure does not mean high risk. AI makes literature and data processing inexpensive, increasing the value of identifying meaningful problems and designing worthwhile research. Teaching and research that only piles up sources and repeats formulas face pressure, while faculty who design high-quality studies and help students produce genuine results become scarcer.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Sociology students should build strong methods: statistics, qualitative research, and programming-based analysis all matter. Join a research team and conduct real surveys as an undergraduate rather than only reading. Academia can remain a goal, but think tanks, internet user research, and policy research are equally strong paths.

Use AI as a literature and data assistant and devote the saved time to research design and fieldwork. Bringing social-computation methods into the classroom creates a differentiated advantage in social-science education. Policy consulting and think-tank partnerships also support promotion and income.

Sociology doctoral graduates should apply beyond universities. Think tanks, survey organizations, internet user research, and public-policy departments all need social researchers. Present research design + methodological ability + implemented outcomes together in interviews rather than listing publications alone.

When hiring social-science teachers and researchers, emphasize methodological capability and problem awareness. Publication quantity is a baseline, not a differentiator. Give faculty AI research tools and real project data so they can produce applicable social research rather than only write papers.

ai_s7_trends: As AI becomes infrastructure for social-science research, problem awareness and research design become faculty's core differentiators.
Social computation and big-data methods are entering sociology classrooms, increasing the value of interdisciplinary skills.
Expansion of think tanks and digital governance extends sociological methods into industry and policy.

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年高校社会学教师在岗约 1.54 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 1.57 万人，净增约 0.03 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.11 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 8.25 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代高校社会学教师，但会接管大量案头活：文献综述、数据清洗、初稿整理、作业批改——这些占社科教师大量时间的劳动正在被 AI 代劳。但社会学教学的核心是「教人思考」：课堂上怎么引导讨论、学生研究设计哪里站不住、结论与材料的边界在哪，这些判断依赖教师的学术积累和价值立场，是 AI 替代不了的。

ai_s3_list: 理论判断：从现象到解释框架，需要学科积淀。
方法指导：学生研究设计的问题，要靠人把脉。
学术伦理：防止 AI 代写与数据造假，把好诚信关。
课堂引导：讨论的节奏、观点交锋的把握。
价值立场：社会关怀与批判性思考的传递。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明社科研究的案头环节——文献、数据、写作——的 AI 接触面相当大，属于中高曝光。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：AI 让文献和数据处理变得便宜，反而放大了「问题意识」的价值——能不能提出好问题、做出有意义的研究设计。被挤压的是只会堆资料、重复套路的教研；会设计高质量研究、能带学生做出真成果的教师，稀缺性在上升。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 学社会学要把方法练硬：统计、质性、编程分析一个不能少。本科就进课题组做真调查，别只读书。把高校当目标没错，但智库、互联网用户研究、政策研究同样是好去处，路子别走窄。
把 AI 用成文献与数据助手，时间省给研究设计和田野。把社会计算方法引入课堂，这是社科教学的差异化优势；同时把政策咨询、智库合作做起来，职称和收入都有帮助。
社会学博士求职别只投高校，智库、调查机构、互联网用研、公共政策部门都在要会做社会研究的人。面试时把「研究设计 + 方法能力 + 落地成果」打包讲，比单列论文更有说服力。
招社科教师与研究员，要重点考察方法能力和问题意识，论文数量是底线不是亮点。给教师配 AI 研究工具与真实课题数据，让他们产出能落地的社会研究，比让他们埋头写论文更可持续。

ai_s7_trends: AI 成为社科研究基础设施，「问题意识与研究设计」成为教师核心差异。
社会计算与大数据方法进入社会学课堂，交叉能力更值钱。
智库与数字化治理需求扩张，社会学方法向产业与政策外溢。

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 230,200 special education teachers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to decline to 226,100 by 2034, a net loss of about 4,100 jobs, with approximately 15,400 openings per year. Median annual pay was about $63,000 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace elementary special education teachers, but it will take over substantial desk work. AI can accelerate IEP drafts, differentiated lesson plans, grading, and data records, shifting teachers' time from writing documents to face-to-face teaching, observation, and intervention. The trusting relationship between teacher and student is truly scarce. It cannot be downloaded and develops one lesson at a time.

ai_s3_list: Behavior intervention: immediate responses to emotional outbursts depend on live judgment and relationships.
Observation and assessment: signals beyond written data are often the most consequential.
Face-to-face teaching: eye contact, tone, and physical interaction provide genuine interpersonal feedback that AI cannot.
Family-school communication: translate professional judgment into language parents understand and can act on.
Trust-building: children with special needs often distrust unfamiliar systems, and people must develop trust gradually.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 reflects that about half the work is desk-based, including IEPs, lesson plans, and records, exactly the areas AI accelerates.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low risk comes from education's person-to-person nature. As AI makes standardized instruction less expensive, personalized development becomes more valuable. Repetitive desk work faces pressure, while student-facing roles continue to require people.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Special education is a strong choice with stable employment and long-term shortages. Before entering, complete an internship in a real classroom to confirm that you can handle the emotional pressure. Study behavior intervention and assistive technology early.

Let AI handle IEP writing and data records, and devote the saved time to student observation and family-school communication. Learning augmentative communication and adaptive-learning tools substantially increases classroom inclusion.

People with backgrounds in education, psychology, rehabilitation, or nursing can enter the field. Earn a special education teaching credential and begin as an assistant or substitute. Special education lacks workers who genuinely remain, making psychological readiness more important than the resume.

Do not hire special education teachers based only on education and credentials; assess patience, stability, and actual classroom experience. AI tools and assistant support reduce desk burdens and are the most effective way to retain strong teachers.

Assistive technology and adaptive learning enable special education teachers to serve more students with more complex needs.

ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业有一半工作在案头——IEP、教案、记录，这些正是 AI 擅长加速的部分。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但低风险在于教学的本质是「人对人」：AI 越强，标准化的「教」越便宜，个性化「育」的价值越高。被挤压的是重复性案头，而面向孩子的岗位始终需要人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 特殊教育专业是好选择，就业稳定且长期缺人。但入行前要实习接触真实课堂，确认自己能扛住情绪压力；把行为干预和辅助技术两门功课提前学起来。
把 IEP 撰写和数据记录交给 AI，把省下的时间投给学生观察和家校沟通。学会用辅助沟通和自适应学习工具，你的课堂容纳度会明显提升。
有教育、心理、康复或护理背景都可以切入，先考特教方向教师资格证，从助教或代课做起。特教缺人，但缺的是「真的能待下来」的人，心理准备比简历重要。
招特教老师别只看学历和证书，要看耐心、稳定性和实际带班经验。给老师配好 AI 工具和助教支持，降低案头负担，是留住好老师最有效的方式。
